spans.s:
योध, अस्, m. a fighter, warrior, champion, com-
batant, soldier; battle, war (in दुर्-य्˚, मिथो-य्˚,
q. q. v. v.); a kind of metre, four times ¯˘¯¯˘¯.
—योध-धर्म, अस्, m. the law of soldiers,
military law, duty of the Kṣatriya caste.
—योध-
मुख्य, अस्, m. a chief warrior, leader.
—योध-
वीर, अस्, m. a hero, warrior.
—योध-संराव,
अस्, m. challenging to battle, mutual defiance of
combatants.
—योध-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying
warriors.
—योधागार (˚ध-आग्˚), अस्, m. a soldier's
dwelling, barrack.
योधक, अस्, m. = योध, a fighter, warrior.

योधन, अम्, n. the act of fighting, battle, war,
strife.
—योधन-पुर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
Tīrtha.
योधनी-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
योधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fighting, making war.

योधिक, epithet of a particular mode of fighting;
[cf. यौधिक.]

योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting, contending, waging
war, (at the end of comps., e. g. दिव्यास्त्र-योधिन्,
fighting with divine weapons; cf. हय-य्˚); con-
quering, subduing, a conqueror (e. g. दानव-
योधिन्, conquering the Dānavas); (ई), m. a warrior.
—योधि-वन, अम्, n., N. of a place.

योधीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of योध), more
warlike or martial.

योधेय, अस्, m. = योध, a warrior, combatant;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a race.
